user_query: I'm creating a movie recommendation website and I need data for the top 100 movies of all time. Can you provide me with the titles, ratings, genres, directors, and years of release for these movies? It would be helpful to have the movie posters and descriptions too.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of the top 100 movies of all time, including titles, ratings, genres, directors, and years of release.
Retrieve detailed information for each movie including posters and descriptions based on the titles fetched in Subtask 1.
